mood: Portrait city photomontage: coral window slab and stepped masonry crowd the left; a needle tower stands across open electric-blue sky. One enlarged blue sedan with scarlet trim floats forward, its dark glazing holding dithered night depth. A hooded signal hangs above. Turquoise boarded porch, silver oval inset, sea-blue splash reflection, branching ground seam and grassy blue-door abutment stay subordinate.
material_language: Opaque coral and electric-blue recoloring over detailed photographic masonry and bodywork.
Crushed black glazing and shadows, with localized dithered nocturnal depth.
Turquoise facade paint and silver-gray ribbed relief around an iridescent inset.
Crisp collage edges, fine multicolored ground traces and a small grassy masonry cap.
lighting: Hard daylight and crushed shadows unite the street; yellow lights and blue-magenta dusk remain confined to the sedan glazing as a deliberate temporal collage.
object_inventory: A tall coral slab with black window rows rises behind stepped brown masonry.
Broad dark sedan glazing holds dithered blocks, yellow lights and railings.
A turquoise boarded porch and painted steps project from muted masonry.
A ribbed silver-gray bodywork inset cups an iridescent blue oval.
A saturated sea-blue reflection with white splash tips curls on the car flank.
Multicolor branching grooves meet pink and green blocks in a black ground seam.
A small grassy abutment holds a round blue door, chimney and leaning ladder.
negative_constraints: No centered avenue, original flanking skyline arrangement, vehicle queue or near-identical reconstruction.
No labels, lettering, logos, numbering, URLs, controls, cards, pins, target rings or debug marks.
No pasted source images, framed reference panels, packaging or miniature picture galleries.
No landscape takeover, full collectible silhouette, cartoon figure, dolphins or literal circuit board.
Do not replace the coral window lattice, angular sedan, needle tower or hooded traffic signal with generic abstractions.
Keep portrait orientation, open blue sky and two dominant masses; subordinate features must remain distinct physical details, not counted symbols.
